convert_bilingual_srt_to_monolingual: convert a bilingual SRT subtitle file to monolingual by keeping only the first language line per subtitle block
run_batch_srt_conversion: run the script to batch convert all SRT files in a folder from bilingual to monolingual format
review_convert_function: review the convert function that parses SRT files and filters bilingual captions to monolingual output
refactor_convert_for_multiple_formats: refactor the convert function to support additional caption formats beyond SRT like VTT or ASS
test_convert_function: test the convert function with a sample bilingual SRT file to verify correct monolingual output
